description: This file declares the ICapture interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It defines methods for capturing screen data and an internal storage interface.

classes.name: ICapture
classes.description: An interface for capturing screen data, including methods to get the name, perform capture, and retrieve an instance.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the capture device or interface.

methods.name: Capture
methods.description: Performs the capture operation using a provided storage interface.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Static method to get the singleton instance of ICapture.

classes.name: ICapture::IStore
classes.description: An internal interface for storing captured image data, with method R8_G8_B8_A8 to process raw buffer data.

methods.name: R8_G8_B8_A8
methods.description: Processes a raw buffer representing an image in R8 G8 B8 A8 format, given buffer pointer and dimensions.

ctags.name: ICapture
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL ICapture : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
